title: Multilevel Determinants of Socioeconomic Disparities in Geographic Late-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma Hotspots
official: Multilevel Determinants of Socioeconomic Disparities in Geographic Late-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma Hotspots
summary: This study evaluates barriers to early detection of liver cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \* Adults (18+)

  * New diagnosis of HCC
  * Able to provide informed consent

Additional criteria:

* Must complete survey
* Residential address in a late stage hotspot
* Medicaid insurance or uninsured
* English, Spanish and Chinese speakers

Exclusion Criteria:

* \* Residence outside of Los Angeles County

  * Non-HCC liver tumors
  * Incarcerated patients
  * Pregnant women
